name: Sword of the Fallen

start.dialog: My lord's sword... I could not protect him. The blade was taken by marauders in the northern dunes. I am... not strong enough to face them alone. Will you help me reclaim my honor?
start.objective: Accompany Cyan to defeat the marauders and recover the lord's sword

progress.dialog: The marauder camp is close. I can smell their fires. My hand trembles... not with fear, but with shame.
progress.objective: Attack the marauder camp and locate the stolen sword

complete.dialog: The sword... returned. My lord can rest now. And I... I can move forward. Thank you. Take this - my family's technique manual. Teach it to those who will use it with honor.

party_comments.kade: Honor is important. I'd do the same for my friends.
party_comments.korr: A soldier's bond to his lord. I understand this.
party_comments.vex: His devotion is... familiar. Painfully so.

hidden_outcome: If you recover the sword without killing any marauders (using sleep/pacify), Cyan teaches you 'Oblivion' - the ultimate bushido technique
